verdict.rationale: Browserbase markets tracking prices, listings and competitor changes 'as they happen' [docs-12], and documents scheduled agent runs [docs-14] plus webhooks that POST when subscribed events occur [docs-19, docs-20]. Together these let a data engineer build a change monitor, but the webhooks are described as platform status events rather than content-diff notifications. The comparison and alert logic appears to be left to the user. Missing for 10: a documented built-in content change-detection/diffing feature, webhook events tied to page-content changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of price/listing monitoring.
